title: Create & Expeditions
description: Modpack based on create and expeditions.
body:
# Create & Expeditions
## About
Fabric modpack based on mod Create. This modpack adds a new generation in your world to explore it, adds mod create and a lot of its addons, Ad Astra, and more! 
## Additional information
I've already played in this modpack with my friends, and they said it's a very good modpack.
You can use any mod/app to host this modpack. (We've tested [playit.gg](https://playit.gg/login?redirect=/account/tunnels?) and [Essential mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential))
